# WeddingInvite

> WeddingInvite is an online wedding and engagement invitation that opens in the browser, made by AnberTech (https://anbertech.github.io/).
> Guests open one link: a sealed marble door opens (sweep the petals with a finger or blow into the microphone, then tap the seal),
> then the invitation shows the couple, the invitation text and families, the date with add-to-calendar, the venue with directions,
> an RSVP form, the weather for the day and a closing card, with background music and a countdown. No app or account is needed.

## Live demo

This site is a live demo with sample data (Elif & Ege, 12 June 2027, Istanbul). Names, date, venue and families are examples.
The demo RSVP form does not send data anywhere; answers stay only on the visitor's device.
The demo is available in 16 languages:

## Guides

- [Online wedding invitation](https://anbertech.github.io/WeddingInvite/en/online-wedding-invitation/): What to include, wording ideas, and when to send the link.
- [Digital engagement invitation](https://anbertech.github.io/WeddingInvite/en/digital-engagement-invitation/): Engagement wording, introducing families, and sending on short notice.
- [Wedding RSVP form](https://anbertech.github.io/WeddingInvite/en/wedding-rsvp-form/): What RSVP means, what to ask, reply-by dates, and reminders.

Guides are available in 16 languages (same paths under each language folder).
